title_en: State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is enacted in accordance with the Constitution to ensure the right of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations to obtain state compensation according to law, and to promote the lawful exercise of functions and powers by state organs.

Article 2 Where a state organ or its personnel, in exercising their functions and powers, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen, legal person, or other organization under the circumstances provided for in this Law and causes damage, the victim shall have the right to obtain state compensation in accordance with this Law.
The compensatory obligation organ provided for in this Law shall perform its compensation obligations in a timely manner in accordance with this Law.

Article 5 The State shall not bear compensation liability in any of the following circumstances:
(1) a personal act of a functionary of an administrative organ which is not related to the exercise of his functions and powers;
(2) damage caused by the act of the citizen, legal person or other organization itself; or
(3) other circumstances provided for by law.

Article 6 The injured citizen, legal person or other organization shall have the right to claim compensation.
Where the injured citizen dies, his heirs and other relatives who have a maintenance relationship with him shall have the right to claim compensation.
Where the injured legal person or other organization is terminated, the successor to its rights shall have the right to claim compensation.

Article 7 Where an administrative organ or its functionary, in exercising its/his administrative functions and powers, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen, legal person or other organization and causes damage thereto, the said administrative organ shall be the organ liable for compensation.
Where two or more administrative organs jointly exercise their administrative functions and powers and infringe upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen, legal person or other organization and cause damage thereto, the administrative organs that jointly exercise their administrative functions and powers shall be the organs jointly liable for compensation.
Where an organization authorized by a law or regulation, in exercising the administrative power granted to it, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen, legal person or other organization and causes damage thereto, the authorized organization shall be the organ liable for compensation.
Where an organization or individual entrusted by an administrative organ, in exercising the entrusted administrative power, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen, legal person or other organization and causes damage thereto, the entrusting administrative organ shall be the organ liable for compensation.
Where the organ liable for compensation is abolished, the administrative organ that continues to exercise its functions and powers shall be the organ liable for compensation; if there is no administrative organ continuing to exercise its functions and powers, the administrative organ that abolished the said organ liable for compensation shall be the organ liable for compensation.

Article 8 Where a reconsideration is made by the organ for administrative reconsideration, the administrative organ that initially caused the infringing act shall be the organ liable for compensation; however, if the reconsideration decision of the organ for administrative reconsideration aggravates the damage, the organ for administrative reconsideration shall perform the compensation obligation for the aggravated part.

Article 9 Where an organ liable for compensation falls under any of the circumstances specified in Article 3 or Article 4 of this Law, it shall grant compensation.
A claimant for compensation shall first submit a claim to the organ liable for compensation, and may also submit the claim together with an application for administrative reconsideration or an administrative lawsuit.
Article 10 A claimant for compensation may claim compensation from any one of the organs jointly liable for compensation, and the said organ shall first make compensation.
Article 11 A claimant for compensation may, on the basis of the different types of damage suffered, submit multiple claims for compensation at the same time.

Article 12 A claim for compensation shall be submitted in the form of a written application, which shall contain the following:
(1) the name, sex, age, work unit and domicile of the victim, or the name and domicile of the legal person or other organization, and the name and position of its legal representative or principal responsible person;
(2) the specific claim, the facts on which it is based and the reasons therefor; and
(3) the year, month and day of the application.
If a claimant for compensation has genuine difficulty in writing the application, he may entrust another person to write it on his behalf, or may make an oral application, which shall be recorded by the organ liable for compensation.
If the claimant for compensation is not the victim himself, he shall state his relationship with the victim and provide the corresponding evidence.
If the claimant for compensation submits the application in person, the organ liable for compensation shall, on the spot, issue a written certificate affixed with the special seal of the said administrative organ and indicating the date of receipt. If the application materials are incomplete, the organ liable for compensation shall, on the spot or within five days, inform the claimant for compensation of all the contents that need to be supplemented or corrected in a single notice.

Article 13 The organ liable for compensation shall, within two months from the date of receipt of the application, make a decision on whether to grant compensation. When making a compensation decision, the organ liable for compensation shall fully hear the opinions of the claimant for compensation, and may, in accordance with the provisions of Chapter IV of this Law, negotiate with the claimant for compensation on the method, items and amount of compensation.
If the organ liable for compensation decides to grant compensation, it shall produce a written compensation decision and serve it on the claimant for compensation within ten days from the date of the decision.
If the organ liable for compensation decides not to grant compensation, it shall, within ten days from the date of the decision, notify the claimant for compensation in writing and state the reasons for not granting compensation.

Article 14 If the organ liable for compensation fails to make a decision on whether to grant compensation within the prescribed time limit, the claimant for compensation may file a lawsuit with the People's Court within three months from the expiry of the time limit.
If the claimant for compensation has objections to the method, items or amount of compensation, or if the organ liable for compensation makes a decision not to grant compensation, the claimant for compensation may file a lawsuit with the People's Court within three months from the date on which the organ liable for compensation made the decision to grant or not to grant compensation.

Article 15 When a People's Court tries an administrative compensation case, the claimant for compensation and the organ liable for compensation shall provide evidence for their respective claims.
Where, during the period when an organ liable for compensation takes compulsory measures such as administrative detention or restriction of personal freedom, the person whose personal freedom is restricted dies or loses capacity for conduct, the organ liable for compensation shall provide evidence on whether there is a causal relationship between its act and the death or loss of capacity for conduct of the person whose personal freedom is restricted.

Article 16 After paying compensation for the loss, the organ liable for compensation shall order its functionaries who acted with intentional or gross negligence, or the entrusted organization or individual, to bear part or all of the compensation expenses.
For the responsible persons who acted with intentional or gross negligence, the relevant organs shall impose sanctions according to law; if the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 18 Where an organ exercising functions and powers of investigation, prosecution and adjudication, or a detention house, prison administration authority, or a functionary thereof, in exercising its/his functions and powers, commits any of the following acts infringing upon the property rights of a citizen, legal person or other organization, the victim shall have the right to obtain compensation:
(1) illegally taking measures such as sealing up, seizing, freezing or recovering property; or
(2) a retrial in accordance with the procedure for adjudication supervision changes the original judgment to a judgment of not guilty, and the original fine or confiscation of property has already been executed.
Article 20 The determination of a claimant for compensation shall be governed by the provisions of Article 6 of this Law.

Article 21 Where an organ exercising functions and powers of investigation, prosecution and adjudication, or a detention house, prison administration authority, or a functionary thereof, in exercising its/his functions and powers, infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of a citizen, legal person or other organization and causes damage thereto, the said organ shall be the organ liable for compensation.
Where a detention measure is taken against a citizen and state compensation shall be granted in accordance with the provisions of this Law, the organ that decided on the detention shall be the organ liable for compensation.
Where, after an arrest measure is taken against a citizen, a decision is made to dismiss the case, not to prosecute, or a judgment of not guilty is rendered, the organ that decided on the arrest shall be the organ liable for compensation.
Where a retrial changes the original judgment to a judgment of not guilty, the People's Court that rendered the original effective judgment shall be the organ liable for compensation. Where a judgment is changed to a judgment of not guilty by a court of second instance, or a judgment of not guilty is entered after a retrial following a remand by a court of second instance, the People's Court that rendered the original guilty judgment in the first instance shall be the organ liable for compensation.

Article 22 Where an organ liable for compensation falls under any of the circumstances specified in Article 17 or Article 18 of this Law, it shall grant compensation.
A claimant for compensation who claims compensation shall first submit a claim to the organ liable for compensation.
The provisions of Article 11 and Article 12 of this Law shall apply to the submission of a claim for compensation by a claimant for compensation.

Article 23 The compensation obligation organ shall, within two months from the date of receiving the application, decide whether to grant compensation. When making a compensation decision, the compensation obligation organ shall fully listen to the opinions of the compensation claimant, and may negotiate with the compensation claimant on the method, items, and amount of compensation in accordance with the provisions of Chapter IV of this Law.
Where the compensation obligation organ decides to grant compensation, it shall issue a compensation decision and serve it on the compensation claimant within ten days from the date of the decision.
Where the compensation obligation organ decides not to grant compensation, it shall notify the compensation claimant in writing within ten days from the date of the decision and state the reasons for not granting compensation.

Article 24 If the compensation obligation organ fails to make a decision on whether to grant compensation within the prescribed time limit, the compensation claimant may, within thirty days from the date of expiration of the time limit, apply for reconsideration to the organ at the next higher level of the compensation obligation organ.
If the compensation claimant disagrees with the method, items, or amount of compensation, or if the compensation obligation organ makes a decision not to grant compensation, the compensation claimant may, within thirty days from the date on which the compensation obligation organ made the decision to grant or not to grant compensation, apply for reconsideration to the organ at the next higher level of the compensation obligation organ.
If the compensation obligation organ is a People's Court, the compensation claimant may, in accordance with the provisions of this Article, apply to the compensation committee of the People's Court at the next higher level for a decision on compensation.

Article 25 The reconsideration organ shall make a decision within two months from the date of receiving the application.
If the compensation claimant is dissatisfied with the reconsideration decision, it may, within thirty days from the date of receipt of the reconsideration decision, apply to the compensation committee of the People's Court at the same level as the location of the reconsideration organ for a decision on compensation; if the reconsideration organ fails to make a decision within the time limit, the compensation claimant may, within thirty days from the date of expiration of the time limit, apply to the compensation committee of the People's Court at the same level as the location of the reconsideration organ for a decision on compensation.

Article 26 When the compensation committee of a People's Court handles a compensation claim, the compensation claimant and the compensation obligation organ shall provide evidence for their respective propositions.
If a detainee dies or loses capacity during the period of custody, the compensation obligation organ shall provide evidence on whether there is a causal relationship between the act of the compensation obligation organ and the death or loss of capacity of the detainee.

Article 27 When handling a compensation claim, the compensation committee of a People's Court shall adopt the method of documentary review. If necessary, it may investigate the situation and collect evidence from relevant units and individuals. If the compensation claimant and the compensation obligation organ dispute the facts of damage and the causal relationship, the compensation committee may hear the statements and defenses of the compensation claimant and the compensation obligation organ, and may conduct cross-examination.

Article 28 The compensation committee of a People's Court shall make a decision within three months from the date of receiving the compensation application; if the case is difficult, complex, or major, with the approval of the president of the court, the period may be extended by three months.

Article 29 The People's Courts at or above the intermediate level shall establish a compensation committee, which shall be composed of three or more judges of the People's Court, and the number of members shall be an odd number.
The compensation committee shall make compensation decisions in accordance with the principle of majority rule.
The compensation decisions made by the compensation committee are legally effective decisions and must be executed.

Article 30 If the compensation claimant or the compensation obligation organ believes that a decision made by the compensation committee is indeed erroneous, it may file a petition with the compensation committee of the People's Court at the next higher level.
After the compensation decision made by the compensation committee takes effect, if it is found that the compensation decision violates the provisions of this Law, upon decision by the president of the court or instruction by the People's Court at a higher level, the compensation committee shall reexamine and make a decision according to law within two months, and the compensation committee of the People's Court at the next higher level may directly examine and make a decision.
If the Supreme People's Procuratorate finds that a decision made by the compensation committee of a People's Court at any level, or if a People's Procuratorate at a higher level finds that a decision made by the compensation committee of a People's Court at a lower level, violates the provisions of this Law, it shall submit an opinion to the compensation committee of the People's Court at the same level, and the compensation committee of the People's Court at the same level shall reexamine and make a decision according to law within two months.

Article 31 After making compensation, the compensation obligation organ shall recover part or all of the compensation expenses from the staff members who fall under any of the following circumstances:
(1) having the circumstances specified in Items (4) and (5) of Article 17 of this Law;
(2) having engaged in embezzlement, bribery, favoritism, or perversion of the law in adjudication while handling a case.
With regard to the responsible persons who have the circumstances specified in the preceding paragraph, the relevant organ shall impose sanctions according to law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 32 State compensation shall mainly take the form of paying compensation money.
If property can be returned or the original condition can be restored, the property shall be returned or the original condition restored.
Article 33 Where the personal freedom of a citizen is infringed upon, the daily compensation shall be calculated on the basis of the average daily wage of employees in the previous year of the state.

Article 35 Where any of the circumstances provided for in Article 3 or Article 17 of this Law causes mental distress to a person, the infringer shall, within the scope of the influence of the infringing act, eliminate the effects, restore the reputation, and make an apology to the victim; if serious consequences are caused, corresponding compensation for mental distress shall be paid.

Article 37 Compensation expenses shall be included in the fiscal budgets at all levels.
The claimant for compensation shall apply to the compensatory obligation organ for payment of compensation money by presenting an effective judgment, a reconsideration decision, a compensation decision, or a mediation document.
The compensatory obligation organ shall, within seven days from the date of receiving the application for payment of compensation money, submit a payment application to the relevant finance department in accordance with the budget management authority, and the finance department shall pay the compensation money within fifteen days from the date of receiving the payment application.
The specific measures for the budget and payment management of compensation expenses shall be prescribed by the State Council.

Article 38 If a People's Court, in the course of a civil action or an administrative action, illegally adopts compulsory measures or preservation measures against obstruction of litigation, or errs in the enforcement of a judgment, ruling, or other effective legal document, and causes damage, the procedure for the claimant for compensation to claim compensation shall be governed by the provisions of this Law on criminal compensation procedure.

Article 39 The limitation period for a claimant for compensation to claim state compensation shall be two years, commencing from the date on which the claimant knows or should have known that an act of a state organ or its personnel in exercising their functions and powers infringes upon the claimant's personal or property rights; provided that the period during which the claimant is in custody or otherwise restricted in personal freedom shall not be counted. If a claim for compensation is made simultaneously with an application for administrative reconsideration or the filing of an administrative action, the provisions of the Administrative Reconsideration Law and the Administrative Procedure Law on limitation periods shall apply.
If a claimant for compensation is unable to exercise the right to claim due to force majeure or other obstacles within the last six months of the limitation period, the limitation period shall be suspended. The limitation period shall continue to run from the date on which the cause of suspension is eliminated.

Article 40 This Law shall apply to foreigners, foreign enterprises, and foreign organizations that claim state compensation from the People's Republic of China within the territory of the People's Republic of China.
If the country to which a foreigner, foreign enterprise, or foreign organization belongs does not protect or restricts the right of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations of the People's Republic of China to claim state compensation from that country, the People's Republic of China shall apply the principle of reciprocity with respect to that foreigner, foreign enterprise, or foreign organization.

Article 41 Where a claimant for compensation claims state compensation, the compensatory obligation organ, the reconsideration organ, and the People's Court shall not charge any fees to the claimant.
The compensation money obtained by the claimant shall not be taxed.
Article 42 This Law shall come into force as of January 1, 1995.
